name: AIFeedbackBar
description: AIFeedbackBar renders a horizontal row of icon-only action buttons below each AI response. Tooltips are portal-rendered above the anchored button to escape overflow:hidden parent containers. Like/disl
intent: Inline feedback controls surfaced after every AI response. Captures user sentiment to improve future outputs and close the learning loop.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: responseText
props.hint: The full response text — passed to navigator.clipboard by the copy action.

forbiddenUsage: Do not use inside a read-only or print view where interactions are disabled
Do not show on mid-stream responses — wait until the response is complete
